Atmo 1.7.0

Atmo 1.7 adds volume controls for the selected Apple TV.

New

  • Volume Up / Volume Down — new volume buttons in the remote (full and mini layouts), Remote menu items with Control-Command-= and Control-Command-Minus shortcuts, atmo://volumeup and atmo://volumedown URL commands, and matching Shortcuts actions. Volume presses behave like the Siri Remote's volume rocker, so they also control TVs and receivers over HDMI-CEC

Requires macOS 14 or later.

Atmo 1.6.0

Atmo 1.6 adds a device Get Info window and smarter install-location detection.

New

  • Get Info — press Command-I (or choose File > Get Info) to open a window with full details about the selected device: model, IP address, identifiers, pairing status, power state, and per-protocol pairing and credential information. The window updates live as you switch devices

Improved

  • Install-location check — Atmo no longer asks you to move it to Applications when it is already in /Applications or ~/Applications, including on first launch of a freshly downloaded copy

Requires macOS 14 or later.

Atmo 1.5.0

Atmo 1.5 refreshes the Settings window with a cleaner, native layout.

Improved

  • Redesigned Settings — settings are now organized into General, Devices, Pairing & Network, and Updates sections using the modern macOS grouped style

Requires macOS 13 or later.

Atmo 1.4.0

Atmo 1.4 adds built-in automatic updates, so this is the last release you need to download by hand.

New

  • Automatic updates — Atmo now keeps itself up to date via Sparkle. On first launch you'll be asked whether to check for updates automatically; you can change this any time in Settings → Updates
  • Check for Updates… — check on demand from the Atmo menu

Requires macOS 13 or later.
